modal.help_s1b: Changer ba Disques mpo na ba volumes mobimba, + Bakisa dossier mpo na kobakisa, x elongoli moko, to coller ba nzela ekopabolami na `;` na Bobongisi. Ko changer ba onglets ebongoli ba dossiers.
modal.help_s2b: Nkombo, Regex (syntaxe Rust), Fuzzy, Makambo ya fichier, Glob (*.rs), Moko na bango (OR) / Moko te na bango (NOT), minene (bytes to 10M/1G), ba date (YYYY-MM-DD), liste ya Exclusion, ba Extension to ba puces ya groupe (ekozwa esika, cliquer lisusu mpo na kolongola; Kamba ebongoli ba personnalisé), Bobosana minuskili/majuskili, Lakisa oyo ebombama.
modal.help_s3b: Bouton monene Scanner & luka to Enter. Rafraîchir elanci lisusu na kobatela sélection. Live elanci automatiquement ba modification (ezima na ebandeli). Ba boluki ya pamba elancete ata moko te — tia * na Glob mpo na nyonso.
modal.help_s4b: Ba titres ya moke e classer, Kende esauti ba pages, ba checkbox eleisaka Copier ba nzela / Tombola / Longola mpe ba export CSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF. Ba boluki oyo ebombama mpe ba snapshot Ya sika ezo yisa filtre nyonso kati ba dossiers, OR/NOT, mpe ebombama.
